# Third-party fixtures: insta360py

`sample.insv` (ONE R, firmware v2.0.0, bare contiguous trailer, legacy calibration string) and
`x5_indexed.insv` (X5, firmware v1.11.6, indexed trailer in an `inst` box) come from the
[ReignBock/insta360py](https://github.com/ReignBock/insta360py) test resources, MIT licensed
(see `LICENSE.insta360py`). Both are real camera trailers with the video payload stripped or
truncated, which is why they are small enough to commit.
